metadata.question: In April 2023, did southern Spain experience temperatures over 90 degrees Fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: ERA5-Land or MODIS temperature data for April 2023 - Date: April 2023 (2023-04-01 to 2023-04-30) - Location: Southern Spain (approximate region around 37°N, 4°W) - Temperature threshold: 90°F = 32.22°C 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for reanalysis data (ERA5) - Question is about temperature values, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid case: Temperature values in reasonable range (-50°C to 60°C) - If max temperature >= 32.22°C, answer is A (Yes) - If max temperature < 32.22°C, answer is B (No) - C1: No images found in collection - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Temperature values are None/NaN or unreasonable ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const southernSpain = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-7.5, 35.5], [-7.5, 38.5], [-1.5, 38.5], [-1.5, 35.5], [-7.5, 35.5]] ]); const startDate = '2023-04-01'; const endDate = '2023-04-30'; const thresholdC = 32.22; // 90°F in Celsius // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(southernSpain) .select('temperature_2m'); const collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No data found for April 2023 in southern Spain.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature // ERA5 temperature is in Kelvin, convert to Celsius tempCollection = tempCollection.map(function(img) { return img.subtract(273.15); }); const maxTemp = tempCollection.max(); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: southernSpain, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTempValue = stats.temperature_2m; // Also check pixel count const pixelCount = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southernSpain, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo().temperature_2m; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Maximum temperature in April 2023: ${maxTempValue !== null ? maxTempValue.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); console.log(`Threshold: ${thresholdC.toFixed(2)}°C (90°F)`); if (maxTempValue === null || maxTempValue === undefined || isNaN(maxTempValue)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid temperature value.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxTempValue < -50 || maxTempValue > 60) { console.log('Temperature value outside reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxTempValue >= thresholdC) { console.log(`Yes, temperatures exceeded 90°F (${maxTempValue.toFixed(2)}°C)`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No, maximum temperature was ${maxTempValue.toFixed(2)}°C, below 90°F threshold`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
